div.head: Iud Dei XII 4.2
div.ab: ut, si de hac ré culpabilis es aut fecisti aut baiulasti aut consensisti aut propter actam culpam denominatam sciens factores iuuisti, ut ęcclesiam non introeas, christianę societati non miscearis, si reatum nolueris confiteri admissum, antequam iudicio examineris puplico.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 420 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: that, if you are culpable in this matter, or did it, or carried [it], or consented, or knowingly helped the doers for the sake of the named offence committed [?], you do not enter the church, nor mingle with Christian society, if you will not confess the guilt you have incurred, before you are examined by public judgment.
